{{Top|leg}}
{{Youmay|an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] utilized by the Rebel Alliance|the [[Infantry Support Platform/Legends|Infantry Support Platform]], a [[Landspeeder/Legends|speeder]] utilized by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]}}

'''Swampspeeders''' were [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]] adapted to serve in [[Swamp/Legends|swampy]] environments or swamp [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] expanded their program of adapting T-47s for specific environments after the success of the [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]]. Swampspeeders were modified with water-sealed thrust nozzles, watertight cockpits, and [[flotation device]]s.<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
